arxiv-2007-00261.title: Photoassociation of ultracold long-range polyatomic molecules
arxiv-2007-00261.creator: Marko Gacesa, Jason N. Byrd, Jonathan Smucker, John A. Montgomery, Jr, Robin Côté
arxiv-2007-00261.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Marko Gacesa, Jason N. Byrd, Jonathan Smucker, John A. Montgomery, Jr, Robin Côté. We explore the feasibility of optically forming long-range tetratomic and larger polyatomic molecules in their ground electronic state from ultracold pairs of polar molecules aligned by external fields. Depending on the relative orientation of the interacting diatomic molecules, we find that a tetratomic can be formed either as a weakly bound complex in a very extended halo state or as a pure long-range molecule composed of collinear or nearly-collinear diatomic molecules.

arxiv-2212-06894.title: IIVA: A Simulation Based Generalized Framework for I nterdependent I nfrastructure V ulnerability A ssessment
arxiv-2212-06894.creator: Prasangsha Ganguly & Sayanti Mukherjee*
arxiv-2212-06894.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Prasangsha Ganguly & Sayanti Mukherjee*. Accurate vulnerability assessment of critical infrastructure systems is cardinal to enhance infrastructure resilience. Unlike traditional approaches, this paper proposes a novel infrastructure vulnerability assessment framework that accounts for: various types of infrastructure interdependencies including physical, logical and geographical from a holistic perspective; lack of/incomplete information on supply-demand flow characteristics of interdependent infrastructure; and, unavailability/inadequate data on infrastructure network topology and/or interdependencies.

arxiv-2405-17609.title: GarmentCodeData: A Dataset of 3D Made-to-Measure Garments With Sewing Patterns
arxiv-2405-17609.creator: Maria Korosteleva, Timur Levent Kesdogan, Fabian Kemper, Stephan Wenninger, Jasmin Koller, Yuhan Zhang, Mario Botsch, Olga Sorkine-Hornung
arxiv-2405-17609.description: Abstract Recent research interest in learning-based processing of garments, from virtual fitting to generation and reconstruction, stumbles on a scarcity of high-quality public data in the domain. We contribute to resolving this need by presenting the first large-scale synthetic dataset of 3D made-to-measure garments with sewing patterns, as well as its generation pipeline.

arxiv-2408-00110.title: The Aldous–Lyons Conjecture I: Subgroup Tests
arxiv-2408-00110.creator: Lewis Bowen, Michael Chapman, Alexander Lubotzky, Thomas Vidick
arxiv-2408-00110.description: Abstract . This paper, and its companion [ 21 ] , are devoted to a negative resolution of the Aldous–Lyons Conjecture [ 6 , 7 ] . This conjecture, originated in probability theory, is well known (cf. [ 37 ] ) to be equivalent to the statement that every invariant random subgroup of the free group is co-sofic.

arxiv-2408-05276.title: Flexible mapping of ringdown amplitudes for nonprecessing binary black holes
arxiv-2408-05276.creator: Costantino Pacilio, Swetha Bhagwat, Francesco Nobili, Davide Gerosa
arxiv-2408-05276.description: Abstract The remnant black hole from a binary coalescence emits ringdown gravitational waves characterized by quasinormal modes, which depend solely on the remnant’s mass and spin. In contrast, the ringdown amplitudes and phases are determined by the properties of the merging progenitors.

arxiv-2408-17143.title: RenDetNet: Weakly-supervised Shadow Detection with Shadow Caster Verification
arxiv-2408-17143.creator: Nikolina Kubiak, Elliot Wortman, Armin Mustafa, Graeme Phillipson, Stephen Jolly, Simon Hadfield
arxiv-2408-17143.description: Abstract Existing shadow detection models struggle to differentiate dark image areas from shadows. In this paper, we tackle this issue by verifying that all detected shadows are real, i.e. they have paired shadow casters. We perform this step in a physically-accurate manner by differentiably re-rendering the scene and observing the changes stemming from carving out estimated shadow casters.

arxiv-2410-03879.title: SONIQUE: Video Background Music Generation Using Unpaired Audio-Visual Data
arxiv-2410-03879.creator: Liqian Zhang, Magdalena Fuentes
arxiv-2410-03879.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Liqian Zhang, Magdalena Fuentes. We present SONIQUE, a model for generating background music tailored to video content. Unlike traditional video-to-music generation approaches, which rely heavily on paired audio-visual datasets, SONIQUE leverages unpaired data, combining royalty-free music and independent video sources. By utilizing large language models (LLMs) for video understanding and converting visual descriptions into musical tags, alongside a U-Net-based conditional diffusion model, SONIQUE enables customizable music generation.

arxiv-2503-09533.title: Large Language Models for Multi-Facility Location Mechanism Design
arxiv-2503-09533.creator: Nguyen Thach, Fei Liu, Houyu Zhou, Hau Chan
arxiv-2503-09533.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nguyen Thach, Fei Liu, Houyu Zhou, Hau Chan. Designing strategyproof mechanisms for multi-facility location that optimize social costs based on agent preferences had been challenging due to the extensive domain knowledge required and poor worst-case guarantees. Recently, deep learning models have been proposed as alternatives. However, these models require some domain knowledge and extensive hyperparameter tuning as well as lacking interpretability, which is crucial in practice when transparency of the learned mechanisms is mandatory.

arxiv-2602-10234.title: Transforming Policy-Car Swerving for Mitigating Stop-and-Go Traffic Waves: A Practice-Oriented Jam-Absorption Driving Strategy
arxiv-2602-10234.creator: Zhengbing He
arxiv-2602-10234.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zhengbing He. Stop-and-go traffic waves, as a major form of freeway traffic congestion, cause severe and long-lasting adverse effects, including reduced traffic efficiency, increased driving risks, and higher vehicle emissions. Amongst the freeway traffic management strategies, jam-absorption driving (JAD), in which a dedicated vehicle performs “slow-in” and “fast-out” maneuvers before being captured by a stop-and-go wave, has been proposed as a potential method for preventing the propagation of such waves.

pmc-11382088.title: Adult-onset asthma induced by COVID-19: A case report
pmc-11382088.creator: Federica Cucè, Marco Visicaro
pmc-11382088.description: COVID-19 commonly presents respiratory symptoms that can linger after the acute phase. Asthma onset or exacerbations have been documented after viral infections although rarely in adults.We report a case of adult-onset asthma triggered by mildly symptomatic COVID-19 in a 24-year-old female without previous respiratory issues.

pmc-11508237.title: Safety and Efficacy of Sodium-Glucose Transport Protein 2 Inhibitors and Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists in Diabetic Kidney Transplant Recipients: Synthesis of Evidence
pmc-11508237.creator: Ioannis Bellos, Pagona Lagiou, Vassiliki Benetou, Smaragdi Marinaki, Hiroshi Tanaka
pmc-11508237.description: Background: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of novel antidiabetics, namely, sodium-glucose transport protein 2 inhibitors (SGLT2-i) and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP1-RA), in diabetic kidney transplant recipients. Methods: Medline, Scopus, Web of Science, CENTRAL, and Clinicaltrials.gov were systematically searched from inception until 25 August 2024. Pooled estimates were obtained by applying random-effects models.

pmc-12594198.title: Quantifying widespread hydrothermal chimneys on the East Pacific Rise flanks between 9°43′ and 57′N
pmc-12594198.creator: Jyun-Nai Wu, Ross Parnell-Turner, Daniel J. Fornari, Thibaut Barreyre, Jill M. McDermott
pmc-12594198.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Hydrothermal circulation at mid-ocean ridges drives the exchange of heat and matter from Earth’s interior to the global ocean and supports deep-sea life. Away from the ridge axis, however, the spatial extent of hydrothermal discharge remains enigmatic. Using near-bottom data for a 25-kilometer-long section of the East Pacific Rise between 9°43′N and 9°57′N, we show that considerable hydrothermal flow occurs at variable distances from the ridge axis.

pmc-12731074.title: Interplay Between Glutamine Metabolism and Other Cellular Pathways: A Promising Hub in the Treatment of HNSCC
pmc-12731074.creator: Teresa Stefania Dell’Endice, Francesca Posa, Giuseppina Storlino, Lorenzo Sanesi, Lucio Lo Russo, Giorgio Mori
pmc-12731074.description: Highlights What are the main findings? HNSCC tumors are highly dependent on glutamine (Gln) metabolism, with GLS1 as a key player in driving tumorigenesis.Targeting GLS1, ASCT2, and c-Myc in HNSCC disrupts Gln metabolism, with promising antitumor effects and potential immune benefits. pmc-13230949.title: A high-gain symmetric-bipolar buck-boost AC-AC converter with step-changed output frequency and rectifier operation
pmc-13230949.creator: Mostafa Karimi Hajiabadi, Ali Mosallanejad, Ahmad Salemnia, Alireza Lahooti Eshkevari
pmc-13230949.description: This paper introduces a new single-phase non-isolated symmetric-bipolar buck-boost alternating current-alternating current (AC-AC) converter, along with its associated commutation method. The topology comprises five switches, which can be implemented using industrialized single- or dual-diode and Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT)/Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor (MOSFET) modules.

pmc-13561186.title: Limb Salvage Using Local Antibiotic Beads for Calcaneal Osteomyelitis With Multidrug-resistant Infection and Chronic Limb-threatening Ischemia
pmc-13561186.creator: Danah Alhunayan, Ahmed Alsaleh, Mahmood Makhdoomi, Salma Khuraibet, Ali Alnaser, Razzaq Alhunayan
pmc-13561186.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Summary:Calcaneal osteomyelitis in diabetic patients with chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI) and multidrug-resistant (MDR) infection poses a significant reconstructive challenge. Limited perfusion, high plantar loading, and constrained antimicrobial delivery often narrow salvage options and increase the risk of major amputation. We report a case of recurrent calcaneal osteomyelitis in a 53-year-old man with type 2 diabetes, chronic kidney disease, peripheral vascular disease, CLTI, and polymicrobial MDR infection.
